note.summary: This is an alphabetical directory listing (D through R) of HMRC internal manuals with links and one-line descriptions. It includes manuals relevant to Self Assessment context such as the Enquiry Manual (how HMRC carries out tax enquiry work), Partnership Manual, Property Income Manual, Repayment Claims Manual, and Residence, Domicile and Remittance Basis Manual, alongside many unrelated manuals (excise, VAT, insurance, oil taxation, etc.).

note.summary: This chunk lists HMRC internal manuals alphabetically from S through Z, with one-line descriptions and links. It includes several manuals directly relevant to Self Assessment: the Self Assessment Claims Manual, Self Assessment: the legal framework, and the Self Assessment Manual, plus related manuals on Scottish and Welsh taxpayer status, Trusts Settlements and Estates, and Savings and Investment. Most other entries (e.g. tobacco duty, VAT, stamp taxes, tonnage tax) are unrelated to Self Assessment.

caveats: Guidance is not comprehensive and not definitive in every case

note.summary: This is an index/navigation page listing HMRC internal manuals alphabetically (A to C shown in this chunk), each with a short description of scope. It includes manuals such as Business Income Manual and Capital Gains Manual which are relevant background for Self Assessment calculations, but the chunk itself is a directory rather than substantive tax guidance. It notes the manuals are HMRC staff guidance, published under the Publication scheme, reflect the law as it stood when published, and are not comprehensive or definitive.
